column1: # unit-map.tsv -- explicit Delphi unit -> parallel lane assignment
# Read by tools/audit-coverage.ps1 (evidence E4). A row here means the unit is
# OWNED BY A LANE AND IN FLIGHT -- it is reported as ASSIGNED, never as MAPPED.
# E1/E2 (real .cs evidence) take PRECEDENCE over E4, so a row whose port has
# already landed is reported MAPPED anyway: a stale row can never hide finished
# work.  Keep the file refreshed once per wave; a row that is no longer in any
# lane's charter must be DELETED, otherwise it hides a real gap from UNMAPPED.
# Key is the basename only, so duplicate basenames (e.g. AsyncCalls.pas exists in
# M2Engine, Client-HGE and RunGate) match all copies; keep that in mind.
# Do NOT add a row for a unit whose lane does not actually own every copy.
# ---- P4 wave (2026-09-20): the four unowned giants ----
# NOTE: ParadoxDataSet.pas exists in BOTH RunGate and GameCenter (same basename,
# 1240 lines each).  No lane owns it yet -- deliberately left UNMAPPED so the
# duplicate-source decision is made once, by the integrator.
# ---- DxComponent tree, owned wholesale by one lane ----
